description: This file defines a static class 'RelationalStorageExtensions' containing extension methods for the 'IRelationalStorage' interface. The methods facilitate executing SQL commands such as batch inserts, reads, and updates, often utilizing reflection for parameter handling and result mapping. The class provides utilities for format-specific operations and stream retrieval adjustments depending on provider capabilities.

classes.name: RelationalStorageExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to facilitate database operations via the IRelationalStorage interface, including batch inserts, reads, execution commands, and stream retrieval.

methods.name: ExecuteMultipleInsertIntoAsync
methods.description: Performs batch insert into a specified table using a multi-record SELECT UNION ALL approach with optional parameterization.

methods.name: ReadAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Reads data from the database using a query and a selector function, with support for parameter objects and cancellation tokens.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a non-query SQL command with optional parameters and cancellation support.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Retrieves a stream from a data reader, using native support if available, or a fallback chunked read otherwise.
